references.purpose: Standard combined absolute and relative comparison and warning that the absolute floor is domain-specific

metricContract.common: Preserve source/revision/file/trace identities, finite values, shapes, exact stage order and closure. Never replay or relabel v9.
metricContract.sourceToQuantized: Keep all existing stage absolute error, NRMSE, cosine, sign population/rate and top-K limits. Report relative and ULP maxima as diagnostics rather than independent fatal requirements for a lossy representation.
metricContract.reconstructedToScalar: Keep all existing hard absolute, NRMSE, cosine, sign, top-K and greedy checks. Except exact embedding, require abs(candidate-reference)<=1e-5+existing stage rtol*abs(reference). Report ULP diagnostically across distinct F32 reduction algorithms.
metricContract.absoluteNoiseFloor: 1e-5 is the existing declared signFloor, proposed prospectively as the absolute noise floor; this is a policy choice requiring review, not a universal mathematical error bound.
metricContract.reporting: Retain all raw maxima and positions; add maximum combined-error ratio and first combined-coordinate failure. Do not substitute display rounding, average over cases, omit layers or hide nonfinite results.
metricContract.exactEmbedding: Raw F32 bytes must agree reconstructed-to-scalar.
metricContract.evidence: Eight bounded synthetic arithmetic/metric checks pass. Full bundle and top-K verification was not executed; no model was loaded.

precisionRecipe.scope: Only existing paired feed-forward normalization, gate and up tensors. Source files remain unchanged.
precisionRecipe.scale: s_j=2^max(0,floor(log2(abs(gamma_j)))) using F32 exponent bits; zero, subnormal and abs(gamma)<1 map to s=1.
precisionRecipe.transformed: gamma'=gamma/s; Wgate'=Wgate*diag(s); Wup'=Wup*diag(s); same epsilon, tensor roles, Q8 quantizer, SLM2 storage and runtime.
precisionRecipe.equivalence: W*diag(s)*diag(gamma/s)=W*diag(gamma) in real arithmetic before quantization. Do not promise bit-identical unmodified intermediate F32 values.
precisionRecipe.sourceOnlyScores: A=W*diag(gamma); E_s=dequant(Q(W*diag(s)))*diag(gamma/s)-A. RMS-normalized input r has norm2<=sqrt(d), so each linear row error is bounded by sqrt(d)*norm2(E_s,row). Compute paired maximum relative row error and relative Frobenius error; zero denominator permits only zero numerator.
precisionRecipe.selection: Compute identity and the one deterministic source-only transform. Select a pair only when both joint error scores are non-increasing and at least one strictly improves; otherwise retain identity for that pair. No exponent search, activation calibration, prompt feedback or answer-driven selection. If no pair improves, record no supported remedy and stop before model execution.
precisionRecipe.invalid: Nonfinite or overflowed transformed values fail. Deterministic F64 score accumulation/order, exact source hashes and source drift checks are bound to the new converter profile.
precisionRecipe.receipt: Bind scale exponents/vector hashes, source gamma/gate/up identities, before/after scores, selected pairs, transformed tensor hashes, exact model identity and explicit algebraic-plus-quantized semantics.
precisionRecipe.traceCoordinates: Preserve raw source and converted trace bytes. Only source-to-converted FFN-normalized coordinates for selected layers map candidate values back by s_j under an explicit new comparison contract; existing original-unit limits remain. Reconstructed-to-scalar compares raw transformed coordinates. All activated/residual/logit stages compare directly.
precisionRecipe.cost: No model-byte/tensor-count or runtime-operation increase. One 1024-element gamma/scale pair is approximately 8 KiB plus existing row buffers; scoring adds bounded sequential source reads. Runtime timing remains unmeasured.

selectiveF32Alternative.status: Not implementation scope unless the bounded rescaling recipe is demonstrated insufficient.
selectiveF32Alternative.boundary: Requires explicit current profile/role policy/parser/runtime matrix support and independent reconstruction, with honest dependent hashes. Current F32 enum does not permit F32 matrix roles.
selectiveF32Alternative.sourceOnlySelection: If later authorized, use the same weighted row-error score under a prospectively frozen per-matrix error budget and total-byte ceiling; no hardcoded historical layer number or prompt outcomes. Exact budget must be approved before any selected candidate execution, not fitted after results.
selectiveF32Alternative.workerConfiguredPeakDelta: Current policy formula includes twice maximumModelBytes; configured allowance grows by twice the model delta when raised accordingly.
selectiveF32Alternative.performance: More matrix bytes must be transferred/read; F32 removes per-weight dequantization but actual speed can improve or regress with bandwidth/cache limits. No timing claim.
